messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Problem with getIntensities/getUnitIntensities
parts:
Hi,

I will look into this when I have more time. For now, do:

cells <- unlist(getCellIndices(cdfOrig,units=1), use.names=FALSE)
getIntensities(extract(csOrig, 1:5), indices=cells)

and

getUnitIntensities(extract(csOrig, 1:5), units=1)

There shouldn't be too much overhead using extract() for this.

/Henrik

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Problem with getIntensities/getUnitIntensities
parts:
Hi,

thanks. I only scanned the code and I couldn't find it and since it
passes the R CMD check I am surprised there were no errors on
documented arguments that are not in the code. Odd.

Anyway, the intention is to *not* support 'arrays' arguments. Instead
one can use the extract() constructor for the same. The reason is to
minimize the risk for bugs etc and simplify the code and the API. The
help pages have been updated.

Henrik
